unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local XML/PDF/OOXML-derived supplements and linked database snapshots support this paper as an E. coli K-12 genome-sequence correction article, not an AMP activity paper. No primary local table, prose section, figure caption, supplement, assay row, or linked sequence row supports a source-verified AMP assay endpoint, target, raw value, unit, toxicity value, or Cas2/defensin mechanism. The remaining AMP labels are database annotations without primary-source assay support in the obtainable local material.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No activity/toxicity records can be source-verified without fabrication; DRAMP/dbAMP AMP labels remain conflict/database-only provenance, and the paper must remain non-publication-grade.

qc_failure_reasons.reason: Linked DRAMP/dbAMP rows associate Cas2/antimicrobial/antiviral labels with this citation, but local primary material does not support AMP identity, assay values, or target-organism activity for those rows.
